description_en: Queries the statistics on the number of different resources by region
description_zh: 按地域维度获取不同资源的数量统计结果
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-resource-statistic-by-region --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --search-region-id cn-shanghai --include-group-desktops true --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeResourceStatisticByRegion

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the service. Valid values: Shanghai and Singapore
parameters.help_zh: 服务地域ID，可选值为上海或新加坡
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The search region ID. This parameter is used to filter desktop information in the specified region
parameters.help_zh: 搜索地域ID。用于过滤出指定地域的桌面信息
parameters.name: search_region_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the statistical results include the number of shared desktops
parameters.help_zh: 统计结果是否包含共享桌面数量
parameters.name: include_group_desktops

AssignedEndUserCount.description_en: The number of assigned users in the current region
AssignedEndUserCount.description_zh: 当前地域已分配的用户数量

ConnectedEndUserCount.description_en: The number of connected users in the current region
ConnectedEndUserCount.description_zh: 当前地域的已连接的用户数量

DesktopCount.description_en: The number of cloud computers in the current region
DesktopCount.description_zh: 当前地域的云电脑数量

DesktopGroupCount.description_en: The number of shared desktops in the current region
DesktopGroupCount.description_zh: 当前地域的共享桌面数量

NetworkPackageCount.description_en: The number of network packages in the current region
NetworkPackageCount.description_zh: 当前地域的网络包数量

PolicyGroupCount.description_en: The number of policies in the current region

RegionId.description_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions (https://next.api.aliyun.com/document/ecd/2020-09-30/DescribeRegions) operation to query the list of regions supported by WUYING Workspace
RegionId.description_zh: 地域ID。可以调用DescribeRegions (https://next.api.aliyun.com/document/ecd/2020-09-30/DescribeRegions)获取无影云桌面支持的地域列表
